hooks.name: Confirm writes to .env.local
hooks.description: Asks for confirmation before any write touches .env.local, so the PicX API key cannot be overwritten or leaked by an automated edit.

action.command: node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{if(/\.env\.local/.test(s)){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{permissionDecision:'ask',permissionDecisionReason:'This writes to .env.local, which holds the PicX API key. Confirm the key is not being overwritten or exposed.'}}))}process.exit(0)})"
